text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Footprints made in a riverbed never last
long. Do
you know why?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
It's because the water keeps flowing.
They get
covered up, one after another.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
But what if those footprints went much,
much
deeper?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
What if those prints went so deep that
no amount
of flowing water could wash
them away?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Aston Machan has been well known
amongst
trainers since long before her
debut.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her talent landed her a spot on the national television show, New Paka, and she's only garnering more and more attention.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But I doubt she'll be able to run her best
if she
feels that she's under pressure
somehow. With a
hot drink in hand, I
enter the waiting area...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After searching for some time, I find
Aston
Machan in the runners' tunnel,
already having
changed her clothes.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
It doesn't have to get you far. But it
does have to
lead to a second step.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Can you do this? Yes, Machan, you can.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It doesn't look like she's noticed I'm
here. And it
doesn't look like she's
feeling any pressure either.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With no indication as to whether she
heard me,
she takes off by herself.
